nonpromotion_rules: installation assessments are independent; no ordinal promotion
LATENT/LOCATED are consumer-simulation binding statuses only
CIVS relations are scoped native_relation records, not generic graph edges
generic owner fields are prohibited where role differences matter
verification support does not transitively prove semantic premises, authority, exposure, or use
graphical-door readiness is decomposed; no convenience boolean
field reconstitution is not a new Change primitive
LOCATED consumer binding requires an attributable observation reference and route
SUPPORTED executable claims carry currentness and do not inherit truth/authority from mechanical execution
empty reference arrays do not satisfy SUPPORTED / OBSERVED / LOCATED evidence requirements
SUPPORTED field-reconstitution and correspondence claims require currentness
Consumer simulations use positive disclosure functions with characterization references; dependency hypotheses do not automatically mean UL.
executable_claim_enforcement: Installation, verification, correspondence, portability/degradation, graphical-door and consumer-support claims carry STRUCTURAL/SEMANTIC/AUTHORITY/OBSERVATIONAL mode.
